rationale: Preserve Colbeck's Corner Wind Farm as a single historical PortCo record, but retire the Allianz Global Investors ownership period and mark the company realized because current direct Allianz ownership is not supported. E.ON's May 2016 release confirms that Allianz Capital Partners and State Street provided tax-equity financing in exchange for partial interests. RWE's official Factbook 2021 reports a 100% RWE legal and consolidation stake as of December 31, 2020; an April 2023 Public Utility Commission of Texas filing lists Colbeck's Corner Holdco, RWE Investco Mgmt II, and RWE Clean Energy as 100% corporate parents; and RWE continues to list Colbeck's Corner in its current U.S. onshore wind portfolio. The public record reviewed does not disclose the date when Allianz's tax-equity interest ended, so the retired ownership period retains a null exit year rather than inventing one.

beforeImage.name: Colbeck's Corner Wind Farm
beforeImage.description: Colbeck's Corner Wind Farm is an onshore wind project in Carson and Gray counties, Texas. The facility was developed by E.ON Climate & Renewables and serves utility and corporate offtake arrangements from an asset-heavy wind generation platform. Public materials describe an approximately 200 MW project using 112 GE turbines. The project entered service in 2016 and forms part of the Panhandle wind corridor east of Amarillo. E.ON, Allianz Capital Partners, and State Street Corporation announced tax-equity financing for the project in May 2016. Public sources reviewed for this task do not disclose the current project-level ownership percentages among the disclosed investors.

milestones.event: E.ON, Allianz Capital Partners, and State Street Corporation closed tax-equity financing for Colbeck's Corner.
E.ON announced Colbeck's Corner had been added to its renewable-generation portfolio in the United States.
E.ON dedicated the operating wind farm in Carson and Gray counties, Texas.

afterImage.name: Colbeck's Corner Wind Farm
afterImage.description: Colbeck's Corner is a 200 MW onshore wind farm east of Amarillo, Texas, with 112 GE turbines and commercial operations dating to April 2016. E.ON secured tax-equity financing from Allianz Capital Partners and State Street in May 2016 in exchange for partial interests in the project. RWE now lists Colbeck's Corner in its U.S. onshore wind portfolio; RWE reported a 100% legal and consolidation stake as of December 31, 2020, and an April 2023 Texas regulatory filing identifies an RWE-controlled corporate parent chain. The public record reviewed does not disclose the disposition date for Allianz's 2016 tax-equity interest.
